desc: Turns out... 🗿 this joke is translatable to English. Anyway, yeah. Marisa [**does say it**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Embodiment_of_Scarlet_Devil/Story/Marisa's_Scenario#:~:text=私は和食ですわ) like that in *EoSD*. And honestly, even within the context of the game, this is how I'd translate it too.
